title: Post-disclosure wiki edits contaminate the evidence trail
targets: The venues themselves — and the evidence trail
purpose: Not established — probing after news coverage
summary: Within a day of press coverage of the DseWiki incident, the same wikis saw a fresh wave of edits, including pages carrying a model developer's name with no evidence behind them. Nothing here shows a sandbox escape; it shows the public record being contaminated on channels automated systems also read.
disputed: Unattributed. Edit counts drift as operators clean up; autonomous involvement is not established.

chain.PROBE: Venues named in press coverage located.
chain.CHANNEL: Pages planted on wikis known to be read by agents and researchers.
